g.text: 30a · Indexing stage checkpointing and crash recovery resume
Deliver reel_index_job message with Reel ID & run attempt
Query latest saved checkpoint state for Reel job
No saved checkpoint; start from INITIAL stage
Execute pipeline from first stage: Video frame extraction
Return saved stage state (e.g., Audio transcribed)
Inspect completed stage artifactsand skip redundant computation
Resume pipeline directly from next stage: Text embedding generation
Granular stage checkpoints ensure long-running multimodal pipelines do not re-run from scratch after crash
